primary_analysis: paired_binary_analysis_v1 will read episode-level deterministic success flags from execution/scoring/task-000001-baseline.json .. execution/scoring/task-000300-guarded.json (result schema paired_binary_episode_v1 v1.0) and compute the preregistered estimand paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline. Unit = intent (paired baseline vs guarded). Primary test = two-sided paired-proportion (McNemar-style normal-approximation), alpha=0.05. Report paired difference, 95% CI, and p-value. Implementation will apply the registered contract fields exactly: result_schema_id=paired_binary_episode_v1, compatible_execution_adapter_families=["synthetic_paired_llm_benchmark_v1","hosted_netops_gvr_v1"], result_schema_versions=["1.0"]. Primary failed-call treatment (contract) = "complete_pair_primary"; prespecified sensitivity = "complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity".
secondary_analyses: baseline_success_rate (proportion of intents with execution-validated correct configs for baseline)
validator–execution discrepancy rate (proportion where validator passed but execution shows unintended reachability change)
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat pairs excluded for technical failure as failures)
uncertainty_quantification: Paired difference 95% CI via normal-approximation for paired proportions (as preregistered). Report exact McNemar-style p-value (normal-approximation). For exploratory summaries apply Benjamini–Hochberg FDR-adjusted p-values where p-values are reported. No human adjudication; all uncertainty computed from automated scoring artifacts.
multiplicity_implementation: One pre-registered primary paired test. All subgroup, secondary and exploratory comparisons reported as exploratory and adjusted with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR; exploratory findings are explicitly labeled and not promoted to confirmatory claims.
contamination_analysis: Use preregistered deterministic contamination filters recorded in execution/task_manifest.jsonl (exact-string match threshold >=95% and k=8-token shingle Jaccard >=0.6 and token-overlap heuristics). Task-manifest artifact path: execution/task_manifest.jsonl (hash: 91564bb69ac692e2fbd6321708863d13938309b5433ef1b211541ba5426df990). All included/excluded decisions logged in that manifest and execution/execution_log.jsonl.
